# Your independent website desk

Live since24October2026: https://dainyelonthemove.com/admin#admin-website . The test website keeps separate content.

You can use this desk on your own phone or computer. Codex/ChatGPT and a locally running preview server are not needed. The existing Firebase website, owner sign-in and database must be available. This release uses the existing free quota; there is no new paid service or AI request. Free quotas and service availability still apply.

## Choose the right workspace

| Workspace | Use it for |
| --- | --- |
| Write | New Travel Stories/blogs, Field Notes and sourced facts; reopen saved entries, choose cover/banner, add chapters/photos and publish or take offline. |
| Website | Text, headings, existing-page photographs/crops, link labels and addresses on Home, About, Stories, Films, Atlas, My kit, Contact, Q&A and existing journeys/notes. Shared footer applies across public pages. |
| Questions | Review and answer questions/community contributions; privately handle contact messages. |
| Calendar | Your Instagram plans and scheduled/published checkboxes. The existing live reminder preference is unchanged; the isolated test calendar sends no mail. |
| Location | Choose the broad city/country you deliberately want to share. |
| Postcards | Edit saved email drafts and preview them; sending/scheduling stays disabled for this no-email release; drafts/previews remain available. |
| Published | Published answers/conversations and shortcuts back to your entries/pages. |

## Edit an existing page

1. Select the page, then the relevant section/chapter. Your most recently opened page/section is remembered in this tab, without storing your writing in browser preferences.
2. Show Everything, Text & headings, Photographs or Buttons & links to find the right control. Hidden fields retain their edits.
3. Change the desired text. Formatting: **bold**, *italic*, [label](https://example.com) and line breaks. No HTML/code is required or executed.
4. For a photo, choose an existing photo from that page or upload your own. Describe the photograph and choose top/centre/bottom crop. Uploads are resized on your device; original metadata is discarded. Unsupported phone HEIC files need a JPEG/WebP export.
5. Save private draft. Your published page stays unchanged. You can reopen this draft on your other signed-in device.
6. Preview this section in the real website layout. Switch between phone and desktop. Links and form submissions are inactive in the preview; the public site has its normal controls.
7. Close preview, use Publish options, check the confirmation checkbox and Publish this section. Confirm the named section. Later editing cancels the review so an old preview cannot approve new content.
8. Open current page to inspect the result. Existing story chapter labels/menu and approximate reading time update; galleries use the current photo and caption. The site search includes published text supplements. Browser heading metadata updates after loading; crawler/social previews still have static-source limitations.

Publishing saves to the website; it sends no newsletter. Publish each edited section separately. Updating a story does not silently rewrite other deliberately separate card descriptions; their text is editable on the page where they appear.

## Recover your work

- Restore original field only changes that private form field. Save/preview/publish if you want visitors to see it.
- Restore original website section removes that section's public overrides and search supplement. Its private draft remains, so you can publish it again.
- Download backup includes the current form and its referenced photos. Restore a section backup requires the same page/section, restores unsaved edits, and remaps uploaded photo IDs. It never publishes automatically.
- Before closing with unsaved changes the browser warns you. Switching to another page/section asks before discarding unsaved edits. Changes from another device produce a revision conflict rather than silently overwriting it. Download your work before reopening a conflicting draft.
- If saving has not confirmed, keep the page open and download a backup. Do not repeat the change on another device while it is uncertain.

## Technical boundaries

The current page layout and branded styles remain shared. Adding/removing whole page sections, changing header navigation, replacing existing raw/background videos, security/privacy policy and the secret journey feed require a technical release. New stories can include YouTube/Vimeo links and up to twelve photos; no original-video hosting/transcoding was added.

This is a database-backed layer over the original static pages. A connection/JavaScript failure shows original static content. Static SEO/social metadata and the original search keywords can still contain original wording; edited public text is added to the onsite search. Future template restructuring can retire a section identifier; migrating existing overrides/backups is part of that technical release, not an automatic promise.

The editor's production namespace is still closed pending an approved release. Do not confuse a test-site publication with a production release or a Postcard send.
